inputs.text: A student in Jaipur had to turn her graduation ceremony into a protest just to get administrative concerns in front of the Deputy Chief Minister. That’s not a failure of student decorum; it’s a failure of institutions to provide channels that people can trust. When leaders stay silent and then call a student’s actions “inappropriate,” they protect authority instead of addressing the problem. Students deserve accountable institutions and a meaningful voice without having to make a public protest of a milestone.
